finalText:
It's building clean now. There were two real bugs hiding behind all that deprecation noise, both from the same bundler bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes retry count as `retryCount`. That crashed the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing backoff flag as an error. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it needed to treat `undefined` the same as `false`.

Fixed both. The build now finishes in 44.9 seconds with 8 warnings, all deprecation noise, and 0 errors.
